newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bankruptcies up 16.5 pct in April-agency.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bankruptcies up 16.5 pct in April-agency.

text.p: Bankruptcies in Argentina rose 16.5 percent in April from March, while filings for protection from creditors rose 16 percent, the Fidelitas credit risk agency said Friday.
Bankruptcies were down 4.4 percent in the first four months of the year from the same period of 1996 and filings in the four months fell 7.5 percent from a year earlier.

Legal action for payments failure rose 26 percent in April from a month earlier. While those lawsuits rose in April from March, they fell 17 percent in the first four months of the year compared with the same period a year earlier, Fidelitas said in a news release.
Closings of current accounts, meanwhile, fell 3.5 percent in April from March to a total of 5,795. Most of those were due to bad checks.
